title: Savepoints — practice
prompt: Two application requests may read or change related records at the same time. You are working on “Savepoints”. Which practice is the strongest next step?
objective: Apply savepoints in a controlled MySQL workflow.

options: Skip testing, assume every SQL engine behaves identically, and apply the change directly to production.
Concatenate untrusted input into SQL text and grant administrator privileges to every application user.
Judge success only by whether the statement returns any rows, without checking expected behavior or edge cases.
Apply Savepoints to a synthetic MySQL lab scenario, write down the expected outcome, and specify how you will verify it safely.

expected_output: Apply Savepoints to a synthetic MySQL lab scenario, write down the expected outcome, and specify how you will verify it safely.

hints: Start with the smallest repeatable example or inspection step.
